body:
I currently live in Los Angeles but I am from a very small town in Northern Wyoming which just so happens to be on the main pipeline of distribution from Denver to Montana.  Although I have never once used meth, it has affected my life greatly.  The uprisings of use started in '95 or '96.  There was a guy in town who knew someone from Denver who traveled to Montana just about every two weeks.  And on his way, he stop by my town and killed it a little more every time he stopped.  It got to the point where everywhere you turned, there was some crank.  You could find tweak faster than anything in that town.  Then finally, the DEA caught on and arrested the main seller in my town.  Everyone thought that it was over.  We couldn't be more wrong.
By the time I graduated high school, most of my friends were hooked.  In fact at that time, I was dating a girl who at one point was the most beautiful girl in school.  Blonde hair, blue eyes, tall, great personality.  She had it all.  Then a good friend of hers got her addicted to tweak.  She would show up to work spun.  She would stay high constantly.  the next thing you know, she wasn't so beautiful.  The whites of her eyes turned yellow.  She would pick her face so badly that it was almost impossible to look at her.  She was older than I was.  She was in college at the time but after about two months of use, she dropped out.  She wouldn't let me help her.  Soon it came to my attention that she was sleeping with her dealer so she could stay high.  The next thing you know, he moved in with her.  That's when things started to get really bad.  He would beat her up, take her car without asking, verbally abuse her.  But she didn't care.  She just wanted to get high.
At that point I had already turned my back.  Not to mention that it made me uncomfortable to go to her house because she was always being watched.  We weren't just being paranoid.  In a town of less than 6,000 it's pretty easy to know when you are being sought out by the police.  I never turned back after I left her.  As far as I know, she is either dead or incredibly fucked.  I know she was arrested at some point.  But just when I thought it was all over, my best friend, spun out of his mind, got into a car accident that nearly killed a doctor.  When the cops searched his car, they found meth, weed, and alcohol.  He missed his court date which lead to a bench warrent.  When the cops finally caught up to him, he was moving an ungodly amount of tweak across state lines.  He is now in jail for trafficing.  another friend of mine just had a kid.  As you guessed it the baby was already addicted.  My friends girl didn't even know she was pregnant.  So she kept smoking, drinking, and using.  Soon after the baby was born, He was busted with conspiracy to posess with the intent to distribute, distribution of meth, and posession and use of a firearm in the act of trafficing.
Everyone involved here were good people.
Although I have never used this drug, I know what can happen.  The shit isn't worth it.  It made them lose friends, family, go to jail, hurt those around them.  For what?  So they could stay up for thirty hours at a time?  Yeah, that sounds like fun.
